Validation: empty F or L returns "Please fill in the Tip force (kN) before calculating."; L = 0 is caught by the denominator guard with "⚠ The Cantilever length (m) is the denominator of this calculation and cannot be 0." and stops, so the in-formula fallback of 1 is never reached.
